pageTitle: Chotta Bheem Play Date — Back to Roots

program.title: Chotta Bheem Play Date
program.description: A joyful, screen-free immersive play experience inspired by the world of Chhota Bheem—where children don't just watch the hero, they step into his story. Designed with care and creativity, this playdate invites children to explore movement, imagination, and teamwork through guided play in a safe, age-appropriate environment.
program.imageAlt: Children enjoying Chotta Bheem themed activities

items.title: What the Experience Includes
items.description:
Through creative spaces, movement games, role play, and a mini expedition, children will:

• Build confidence and courage
• Experience teamwork and cooperation
• Engage their imagination and creativity
• Enjoy joyful, free-flowing play without screens

Each activity is thoughtfully curated to encourage participation, expression, and connection.

items.title: Why Kids Love It
items.description:
• They step into the fun world of Dholakpur
• They play, move, and imagine like Bheem
• They create, explore, and share joyful moments with peers
• They feel included—whether shy first-timers or energetic explorers

items.title: Age-Appropriate & Inclusive
items.description:
Activities are adapted for different age groups, ensuring:

• Gentle encouragement for shy children
• Engaging challenges for active participants
• A sense of comfort, safety, and belonging for every child

items.title: Take-Home Joy
items.description:
Every child goes home with:

• A pocket full of souvenirs
• A heart full of stories and memories

items.label: What to bring
items.value: Play clothes, water bottle, snack box

items.label: Take home
items.value: Handmade laddus, character drawings, Bheem storybook
